summary: Full first-pass testing of CASEWISE LEGAL PERDATA (FastAPI + React + MongoDB). Backend: 49 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covering auth, dashboard, master-data, cases CRUD/search/filters, maker-checker approval (CREATE/EDIT/DELETE_NONAKTIF/DELETE_PERMANENT, approve+reject), operasional/agenda/timeline, documents (PDF upload/download/delete + non-PDF reject), export cases/database/template, import preview+execute, users CRUD/role guards → 48 passed, 1 failed (no brute-force lockout). Frontend: 5 Playwright runs on the public preview URL covering login (valid/invalid), dashboard (KPI 12 aktif / Rp 12.328.500.000 / 8 region, 13 tahap cards, 15 chart surfaces, 6 reminders), Data Perkara (12 rows, search, filters, Excel export), multi-tab input form with dynamic CIF/loan auto-total, end-to-end approval (create→MENUNGGU→approve→case visible; edit→reject with reason; delete NONAKTIF→approve→status TIDAK AKTIF + alasan), case detail (agenda→timeline, status/risk update persisted, PDF upload/delete, non-PDF rejected), Timeline page, 9 report types + export, User Management (create/toggle/inactive login blocked), Database Management (export xlsx, last-backup info, template, import preview with error table → BATALKAN and LANJUTKAN IMPORT), role guards (/users & /database redirect for admin_legal; menus hidden), mobile 390px nav. All core flows work; issues are security/hardening + minor UX.

critical.issue: Duplicate nomor_perkara not re-validated at approval time. Two pending CREATE requests with the same nomor: first approve OK, second returns 500 Internal Server Error (Mongo DuplicateKeyError on unique index) and the request stays stuck at MENUNGGU forever. Reproduced: POST /api/cases twice (same nomor) as admin → approve both → 2nd = 500.

minor.issue: No rate limiting / account lockout — 6+ consecutive wrong passwords all return 401 (playbook expects lockout after 5 fails, 423/429).
Token is returned in JSON only and stored by the frontend in localStorage; backend reads an 'access_token' cookie but never sets an httpOnly cookie. Deviation from the auth playbook (XSS exposure).
allow_credentials=True combined with CORS_ORIGINS='*' is an invalid/insecure combination; browsers reject credentialed requests. Use explicit origins.
Non-idempotent for credentials: seeded depthead/admin passwords are only set if the user does not exist; changing the seed password will not update an existing account.
Always returns {ok:true} even for non-existent case/agenda (no 404, no auth-scoped validation).
Bulk import creates/updates cases directly with no maker-checker approval record, bypassing the audit trail required for all other data changes (dept_head only, so low severity but inconsistent).
Request bodies are raw dicts (no Pydantic models); only nomor_perkara is validated. status_perkara/risk_rating are not validated against master lists on create/edit (they are on PATCH /operasional).

openpyxl.load_workbook on arbitrary uploads has no size limit and float() casts on loan/jaminan cells can raise an unhandled 500 for non-numeric cells (documents endpoint reads the whole file into memory before its 20MB check).

issues: Native browser date pickers (input type=date) are used instead of the shadcn Calendar component; placeholder shows US 'mm/dd/yyyy' format in a Bahasa Indonesia app
For the admin account the name and role render identically ('Admin Legal' / 'Admin Legal'), looking like a duplicated line
Console a11y error: DialogContent (SheetContent) requires a DialogTitle — add a visually-hidden title
Recharts logs repeated 'width(-1) height(-1)' warnings on mount/route change (ResponsiveContainer inside an initially zero-size container); charts still render but console is noisy

action_items: Re-validate nomor_perkara uniqueness inside apply_approval() for CREATE (and EDIT) and return 400 with a clear message instead of a 500; mark such requests REJECTED/failed instead of leaving them MENUNGGU
Add login rate limiting / lockout after 5 failed attempts (per username+IP) with 423/429 response
Replace CORS_ORIGINS='*' with explicit origin list (allow_credentials=True requires it); optionally issue an httpOnly cookie in addition to the Bearer token
Make seed_database idempotent for passwords (update password_hash of existing depthead/admin when seed value changes)
Add Pydantic request models for /api/cases POST/PUT and validate status_perkara/risk_rating against master lists; return 404 from agenda delete when not found
Split /app/backend/server.py (919 lines) into modules (auth, cases, approvals, documents, export/import, seed)
Replace native date inputs with the shadcn Calendar/DatePicker and use dd/mm/yyyy locale formatting
Add a visually-hidden DialogTitle to SheetContent to clear the a11y console error
critical_code_review_comments: apply_approval() writes to db.cases without re-checking business invariants — any Mongo constraint violation surfaces as an unhandled 500 and corrupts approval state (confirmed with duplicate nomor_perkara)
server.py is 919 lines and mixes auth, CRUD, file handling, Excel export/import and seed data — violates the <700 line / single-responsibility guideline
get_current_user(request) is typed loosely (imports Request inside the function) — use a proper dependency signature; role checks are only via dept_head_only, there is no per-record ownership check
No user delete/hard-delete endpoint exists, so accounts created by admins/tests accumulate permanently (only aktif toggle)
Import float() conversions and openpyxl parsing lack try/except → malformed spreadsheets produce 500 instead of a validation error row

It self-cleans created cases/approvals but leaves created users (no delete API) — remove users matching ^testuser via Mongo after runs. rca_of_the_issue: Duplicate approval 500: create_case() checks nomor_perkara uniqueness only against db.cases at request time, but the case document is inserted later in apply_approval(). With a unique index on cases.nomor_perkara, approving a second pending CREATE for the same nomor raises pymongo DuplicateKeyError, which is not handled → FastAPI 500, and because the update of the approval status happens after apply_approval(), the request remains MENUNGGU. Fix: wrap apply_approval in try/except, re-check uniqueness, and return HTTP 400 with a Bahasa Indonesia message.
